verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party benchmark dataset, WER methodology, or evaluation write-up backing AssemblyAI's accuracy claims. The docs only make accuracy assertions, such as Medical Mode improving terminology accuracy. Community threads report that commenters asked for WER benchmarks (LibriSpeech, TED) and found none, and that marketing claims like "world's most advanced" lacked supporting methodology. Those threads are old launch-era discussions, so current documentation may differ, which is why confidence is medium rather than high.
